name: Private Showroom Viewing
subtitle: Exclusive 1-on-1 access to our private vehicle vault and technical specs.
description: Explore our collection through a personalized private appointment guided by a senior automotive curator. Inspect carbon-fiber architecture, aerodynamic aero tunnels, and bespoke vehicle histories in complete privacy with complimentary hospitality.
inclusions: Option to configure bespoke acquisition allocations

name: Track Experience
subtitle: Get behind the wheel and unleash genuine motorsport capability on circuit.
description: Step out of the paddock and onto the tarmac. Includes professional driver debriefing, vehicle dynamics orientation, radio communication link, and three 15-minute high-speed stints driving exotic supercars with one-on-one professional coaching.
inclusions: FIA-certified helmet, HANS device & Nomex suit fitting
Bespoke telemetry analysis (corner exit speed, braking G-force)
Dedicated pit crew & tire technician support
GoPro 4K cockpit video telemetry package with data overlay

name: Performance Consultation
subtitle: Speak directly with an automotive specialist about your next machine.
location: RouteOne Engineering Studio or Virtual Suite
description: Speak with a RouteOne automotive specialist about acquiring, leasing, or custom-building your next performance machine. We review market allocations, depreciation hedging, track-pack specifications, and private member exchanges.
inclusions: Bespoke vehicle specification and option audit
Track setup optimization matrix (camber, toe, tire pressures)
Direct consultation with RouteOne Chief Engineer

name: Collector Experience
subtitle: A curated multi-car circuit program for serious collectors and drivers.
description: A bespoke tier designed for collectors seeking back-to-back comparisons across naturally aspirated V12s, twin-turbo V8s, and the RouteOne R1 concept. Includes VIP pit lane hospitality, private mechanic, and personal racing instructor.
inclusions: Back-to-back testing of 3 exotic supercars + R1 concept simulator
Private pit lane garage with dedicated race technician
Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 R tire allocation
Private dining experience by Michelin-starred guest chef
